method: Measured in the Claude desktop browser pane against the live site, not Lighthouse. `npx lighthouse` was not available in the audit sandbox, so these come from the Performance API (navigation, paint, largest-contentful-paint, layout-shift) and from computed styles resolved to sRGB through a canvas. Single-machine, warm-cache, desktop viewport 1440x900 — directional, not a lab score.

performance.reading: TTFB is fast (19-76ms, the Vercel edge answering). The ~3s is the server component render: /dashboard is force-dynamic and runs getUser() plus three uncached PostgREST queries per request, so LCP is server time, not asset weight. CLS 0.

contrast.note: Leaf text nodes in header and main, deduplicated by colour pair and font size. Non-text contrast (1.4.11) was not measured programmatically.

keyboard.skip_link: present, first in tab order, reveals on focus
keyboard.focus_visible: yes — a 3px ring from :focus-visible in globals.css, confirmed by real Tab presses, not programmatic focus
keyboard.focus_not_obscured_2_4_11: pass at the point tested — focused control at y=537, sticky header ends at y=57
keyboard.cards: each card is a <button> with an accessible name, e.g. 'Chevening Scholarships — UK. Open details.'

structure.duplicate_ids: the filter panel renders twice — desktop rail and mobile sheet — so every filter id (degree-Masters, noWorkExperience, coversTuition, …) appears twice in one document; the second copy's inputs lose their label association
structure.footer: none — no site-wide disclaimer, privacy or methodology link

seo.metadata: title + description on the root layout only
seo.per_programme_url: none — details open in a client-side sheet, so no scholarship has an indexable URL
